name: claims-management-system
description: Full-stack claims management system (NestJS + Angular + MongoDB) — Bdeo technical challenge.

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install
scripts.dev: pnpm run db && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "pnpm -C backend run start:dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && pnpm -C frontend start"
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend run build && pnpm -C frontend run build
scripts.test: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend test
scripts.test:cov: pnpm -C backend run test:cov && pnpm -C frontend run test:cov
